description: A precision knob control for Uno Platform drawn with SkiaSharp: a brushed-metal knob with physics-based rotation, detents with haptic and audio clicks, and two modes on one control. A segmented switch flips it between a volume knob (a dashed arc with detent ticks, 0 to 100) and a radial menu dial (five Phosphor-icon items with a cone of light). Both modes take the keyboard (arrows, PgUp / PgDn, Home / End; Enter confirms a menu item) and expose an automation peer (a slider, or a spinner whose value is the selected item). The app starts in Dark and Light is complete.

showcase.summary: Brushed-metal knobs with a brass-to-copper arc, a matching readout and segment bar, fine steps, keyboard control and locked states.
goals: A custom control drawn on an SKCanvasElement by small renderer classes, now with the sheet's continuous ring (ArcStyle) and hot range
PrecisionDialChannel: a templated control that keeps arc, pointer, digits and segments on one value, with VisualState groups for focus, Fine / Max and Disabled
Keyboard steps, Shift / Fine 0.1 steps on drag and keys, and a slider automation peer
Vertical or angular drag with a spring; detents with haptic and audio clicks; a radial menu mode on the same knob
Design tokens in Light and Default theme dictionaries, bundled static fonts, and the knob staying dark metal in both themes
Responsive host: three sizes on a panel from 800 px, one knob with steppers below
Hot Design previews of each channel state and of every dial variant
